sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Announces Summer '26 Release: Agentforce Multi-Agent Orchestration Goes GA
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce's Summer '26 release, rolling out June 5–15, brings Multi-Agent Orchestration to general availability, enabling AI agents to collaborate as a unified team with shared context across all customer channels. The release also introduces Agentforce Self-Service (configurable in 6 clicks), Slack-First Sales for pipeline management inside Slack, and Real-Time Offer Management for personalized, channel-optimized promotions.
sfdc_news.relevance: Salesforce customers can now deploy coordinated multi-agent workflows at enterprise scale without custom orchestration code, marking the shift from AI experimentation to production-grade deployment.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Named Snowflake 2026 APJ Product Growth Partner of the Year
sfdc_news.summary: Braze was recognized as Snowflake's 2026 APJ Product Growth Partner of the Year, with a deepened integration that introduces real-time user profile streaming directly to Snowflake instances. Braze also received Snowflake industry competencies across retail, media and entertainment, and financial services verticals.
sfdc_news.relevance: Braze customers using Snowflake can now stream comprehensive customer profiles in real time, enabling richer data warehouse-driven personalization and more powerful downstream analytics.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Launches AI Agents for In-Platform Content Generation and Real-Time Decisioning
sfdc_news.summary: Braze's March 2026 release introduced Braze Agents, AI-powered helpers embedded directly in the dashboard that generate personalized copy, make real-time decisions, and enrich catalog data automatically. The same release added a Messaging Diagnostics dashboard for spotting delivery trends and diagnosing sending issues, and opened a new JP-01 data center for Japan-based customers.
sfdc_news.relevance: Marketing teams can now use native AI agents inside Braze to automate content creation and real-time decisioning without leaving the platform or stitching in external AI tools.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Introduces Agentic AI Analytics for the Next Era of Product Experiences
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude launched a suite of AI agents — a Global Agent plus four specialized agents — that continuously analyze product usage, surface actionable insights, and recommend next steps in real time. The launch also included Model Context Protocol (MCP) updates connecting Amplitude's behavioral data to tools from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, Figma, Lovable, Notion, and GitHub.
sfdc_news.relevance: Product teams can now receive proactive AI-driven recommendations grounded in actual behavioral data, delivered directly inside the tools they already use for planning and shipping.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude June 2026 Product Release: Global Agent, New Event Streaming Destinations, and Datepicker Overhaul
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude's June release focuses on speed, simplicity, and scale with a revamped datepicker for more flexible chart and cohort building, the ability to add markdown-supported event descriptions directly from charts, and four new event streaming destinations. The Global Agent now connects to Slack, Atlassian, GitHub, Sentry, and more, enabling cross-source queries and actions without leaving Amplitude.
sfdc_news.relevance: Amplitude users gain tighter integrations with their existing toolstack and AI-driven cross-tool insights, reducing context-switching for product and data teams.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Pledges $200 Million to Research AI's Economic Impact as CEO Suggests Job Loss Solutions
claude_news.summary: Anthropic announced a $200 million Economic Futures Research Fund to study AI's impact on jobs and the broader economy. The company is also launching a $150 million national fellowship program to help early-career professionals leverage AI across American communities. CEO Dario Amodei has suggested policy-level solutions to address anticipated job displacement from AI.
claude_news.relevance: Anthropic is taking a proactive stance on AI's societal consequences, which signals the company's growing influence on AI policy and workforce discussions.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Calls for Global AI Pause Over Claude Self-Improvement Capabilities
claude_news.summary: Anthropic revealed that Claude now writes more than 80% of its own code, up from under 10% in early 2025, raising alarms about AI systems approaching autonomous self-improvement. The company urged top AI labs worldwide to consider a coordinated slowdown or temporary pause on developing the most powerful AI systems. Anthropic executives warned this trajectory could soon allow AI to design and develop its own successor with minimal human oversight.
claude_news.relevance: This marks a significant safety inflection point for Claude and the broader AI industry, with direct implications for how frontier models are governed and developed.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5, Its First Publicly Available Mythos Model
claude_news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, the first publicly accessible version of its advanced Mythos model family. The model is state-of-the-art on nearly all tested benchmarks, with exceptional performance in software engineering, vision, scientific research, and long-context tasks. A more restricted version, Claude Mythos 5, was also introduced for trusted-access users with additional safeguards.
claude_news.relevance: This is Anthropic's most capable publicly available model to date, offering significantly improved coding, reasoning, and multimodal abilities for Claude users.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Files for US IPO as Investors Bet Big on AI Future
claude_news.summary: Anthropic filed confidentially for an initial public offering, setting up a major public-market test of the AI industry's boom. The company announced it raised $65 billion in a recent funding round, pushing its valuation close to $1 trillion, and is now generating $47 billion in annualized revenue from Claude subscriptions. The IPO filing marks a major milestone for one of the world's leading AI safety companies.
claude_news.relevance: Anthropic going public would be one of the largest tech IPOs in history and a defining moment for the AI industry's commercialization.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Expands Partnership with Google and Broadcom for Next-Generation AI Compute
claude_news.summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with Google and Broadcom to secure multiple gigawatts of next-generation compute capacity. The deal is aimed at supporting the training and deployment of increasingly powerful Claude models. This infrastructure investment underscores Anthropic's aggressive scaling strategy as it competes at the frontier of AI development.
claude_news.relevance: Securing massive compute resources positions Anthropic to continue training frontier models and meet surging enterprise demand for Claude.
